model_layout.semantics: For the current serial layer-ordered H2D batch when COW waits on layer38: all Mamba transfers and 9/10 equal-sized FULL layers in that batch precede the barrier. This is not a proportion of the entire agent context or evidence of exposed GPU stall.

limitations: Live V73 inputs are separate bounded complete-line prefixes, not an atomic snapshot.
V73 has no completed same-arrival-table native comparison yet.
Historical native and predictive arms differ in versions and realized demand.
Dependency probes sample every16 load-consuming prefills; no extrapolation to all requests.
A first wait at layer38 identifies the current pre-forward COW fence; a first wait at layer0 records no such Python fence in that sample.
Direct Host-to-request Mamba loading can avoid checkpoint-to-request D2D COW; Host-hit counters alone do not identify every per-request copy.
Resident Mamba COW with no current H2D consumer is outside these load-consuming samples and does not imply new state restoration.
Transfer ACK batches include tagged predictive loads; first-service cached_host counters are logical request evidence, not physical byte receipts.
Waiting until layer38 constrains data readiness, but elapsed waiting can be tiny when earlier CPU/GPU work already overlaps the copy.
Only missing data in the current restore batch is covered by the 90percent FULL /100percent Mamba frontier, not already resident context.
Wait-event CUDA timing includes event overhead; small values are not identifiable DMA stalls. No per-module JCT saving is inferred.
